lines.plain: Good morning, and welcome aboard! Your sentence begins on the way down.
Welcome aboard! Every floor you visit brings your freedom a little closer. Statistically.
Welcome back! Your debt to society has been calculated. Please don't ask to see it.
Good morning, crew! Today's descent is brought to you by the court's decision. Enjoy your stay.
Please keep your arms, legs and hopes inside the car. Going down shortly.
Doors opening! This floor used to be a hospital. It may still think it is.
Doors opening! Please collect your belongings, and anything else you find.
Doors opening! Remember, anything you record belongs to us. Anything that follows you is yours.
Here we are! Mind the gap, and the staff.
Doors opening! The lights on this floor are on for your comfort. Mostly.
The car is leaving now! Call any time. It usually comes.
We'll be just upstairs! Please enjoy the quiet.
Off we go! The car cannot wait on an occupied floor. You understand.
You're in good hands! Not ours.
The car is now leaving. Should you need us, press the button, and be patient.
Thank you for calling! Your car is on its way. Everyone on this floor now knows.
Your call is important to us! Please wait right there, exactly where you are.
Call received! Estimated arrival: soon. Estimated company: sooner.
Your car has been requested. Try to stay somewhere we can find you.
We heard you! So did the floor.
Your car has arrived! Please board promptly, and with everyone you came with.
Your car is here! We missed you.
Here we are! The doors are open. They will not stay that way.
Your car has arrived. Please count your crew. We already have.
All aboard! Walking is permitted. Running is understood.
Doors closing! Please stand on the side of your choice. Choose freely!
Doors closing! Anyone still outside will be welcomed back... eventually.
Doors closing! Red side goes down, yellow side goes home. No pressure!
Last call! The doors do not check who is in them.
Closing now! If you can hear this from the corridor, wave goodbye.
Going down! Deeper floors pay more, for reasons we have chosen not to explore.
Next stop, further down! Beneath the storage halls, you'll find more storage halls.
Going down! Each floor was built on top of the last. Nobody remembers what the first one was for.
Further down we go! The pay improves. The air does not.
Going down! Fun fact: this shaft is older than the building. All of the buildings.
Congratulations! Your findings have been banked, and your freedom is now slightly nearer.
Banked! At this rate you will be free in... we'll let you know.
Welcome back to the surface! Your earnings are safe. You may now go down again.
A member of your crew has been reassigned. Their sentence is complete!
One of your crew has been admitted. Visiting hours are over!
A crew member is no longer recording. Their equipment may be collected.
The staff have found one of you! Please continue working.
And that is everyone! Thank you for your service. A new crew will be along shortly.
That concludes today's descent! All sentences served. In a manner of speaking.
Nobody left to board. The car thanks you for your patience!
Nobody has ever finished their sentence.
It was a hospital before you came. It will be one after.
Thank you for travelling down with us! Have a wonderful floor.
Where were we? Ah yes. Enjoy your floor!
To bring your car faster, we are borrowing this floor's lights. Back in a moment!
Attention, crew. Lighting on this floor will be unavailable for a short while. Please move about freely!
The lights are going out now. It is nothing to worry about. You may wish to run.
And we're back! Your car is here. Do hurry.
Lights restored! Please make your way to the car. It is exactly where you left it.
Your car is on its way! One more round before we go!
Hide.
Coming, ready or not!
Found you!
All done!
Forty.
Thirty.
Twenty.
Ten.
Nine.
Eight.
Seven.
Six.
Five.
Four.
Three.
Two.
One.
